description: Urban Traffic Simulation Data from Real Fusion Estimates is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Fábio Gonçalves, Gonçalo O. Silva (Universidade do Minho UM). The datasets contain vehicle data from the simulation of the city center of Guimarães. The simulation was created using data collected from real sensor data, thus, providing an accurate view of the traffic flows. The data contains route information, fuel consumption, emissions, driving distance, and the amount of time each vehicle is stopped. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
